You do have a VantageScore 3.0 of 612 right now, up from 603 on 2026-09-15. That's a different model from FICO, so some lenders may see a score when others don't.

What helps in the meantime is simple. Your 4 payments so far have all been on time. Keep that going, and your next payment is due 2026-11-01. A payment 1 to 29 days late isn't reported as late, but at 30 or more days past due it is, so paying on time is the safest path.
